what: A horizontal scroll strip made of several picture panels. When the section top touches the top of the screen it is pinned, and while the page scrolls down by the strip width, the strip moves left by (strip width − screen width) (no curve, follows the scroll with a 1 second scrub lag). Strip width is (100 × panel count + 20)%, and a single panel can be widened to 1.15 times. While a panel with a color set passes the screen center (its left edge → right edge), the section background gradient’s angle, three colors and center position change from the previous panel’s values to this panel’s with easeInOutQuad. If a via value is given, the first half changes up to it and the second half changes straight from it. A story scroll where the background turns over from panel to panel, as day falls and the sky flips
ease: none (band) · easeInOutQuad (gradient) · straight (when passing through via)

options.[data-fx-part=track]: Push strip — one child, one section
options.data-grad (Panel): Initial background ‹angle | top color | middle color stop | bottom color› — ‹180 | var(--kf-bg) | color-mix(in oklab, var(--kf-surface) 50%, transparent) 53 | var(--kf-accent)›. The CSS initial background is also painted with the same value.
options.data-grad (Section): Background once that section has fully passed the screen center (same type). Only sections that list it change the background
options.data-grad-via (Section): Background passed through on the way (same shape) — when given, it straightens half at a time (original section 5: 0° → 90° → 180°)
options.scrub: Trailing delay in seconds, default 1 (2 on phone)
options.wide: ”3:1.15” as section number:width multiplier (commas for several), no default
options.extra: Share added to band width (%), default 20
options.from · upto: Pushing panel width range (px) — default 1 and up, everything. Split two versions like PC version from: 601 and phone version upto: 600

note: Colors are resolved to rgba when applied, so after changing the skin they must be applied again to pick up the new colors. Outside the push width or with reduced motion, sections stack vertically at one screen height each and the background stays at the initial CSS value. Sites that use different sets by width (6 sheets on PC, 9 on phone) apply from and upto separately to the two sets and hide the unused set with CSS
